buckets.title: Fitness & Fatigue
buckets.text: Nothing decisive on freshness, though it tilts slightly to Burillo. Samson has logged 104 games across 5 matches in 14 days, Burillo only 71 across 4.

buckets.title: Motivation & Pressure
buckets.text: Burillo gets a slim nod on motivation and pressure. Over 90 days Burillo's Elo has moved +159 against +15 for Samson.

buckets.title: Conditions
buckets.text: Burillo gets a slim nod on conditions. Surface Elo versus overall Elo: Burillo +31, Samson -11, so Burillo is the better fit for Clay.
